# NVO987

> NVO987 – Culture Visuelle Moderne et Contemporaine

## About

NVO987 is a French cultural and research organization dedicated to modern
and contemporary visual culture, art history, visual studies, education,
research and cultural engagement.

## Organization

- Website: https://nvo987.fr/
- Person: https://nvo987.us/
- Identity: https://identity.nvo987.us/
- DID: did:web:identity.nvo987.us
- Contact: https://nvo987.fr/contact.html
